method_notes: Enfield 'Applying for a Primary School' booklet (Sept 2026 entry), 'Admission arrangements in Enfield', criterion f: children living nearest to the school 'measured as the crow flies, that is, in a straight line from the child's home to the main entrance of the school', calculated by the admissions IT system using AddressBase Premium (0.1 m grid reference within the addressed building). Flats sharing one address point: lowest door number numerically/alphabetically first. Within any criterion, ties broken by distance as in (f). Criteria: EHCP, LAC/previously LAC, exceptional medical, siblings, children of staff (2+ years), priority zone residents (Brettenham, Chase Side, Fleecefield, Lavender, Raynham), then distance. These criteria apply to community schools and to academies in the Connect Education, EdAct, Ivy Learning, Attigo and Children First trusts; VA schools, Northstar free schools, Ark, Oasis, One Degree, De Bohun, Wolfson Hillel and Meridian Angel set their own criteria (not individually checked). The figure used is the council's 'Furthest Distance (Miles)' column.

gaps: 2026 figures come from the council's 16 April 2026 breakdown PDF, downloaded by hand (enfield.gov.uk blocks automated access); 2023 has been dropped now that 2026 is in. The council table covers community schools, academies and free schools; VA faith schools appear only in the 'demand met' lists, so oversubscribed VA schools (Forty Hill, Freezywater St George's, St Monica's 2025/2024; St Michael's 2025; St Paul's 2025/2024; St Andrew's Enfield 2024) are not_published. Academies outside the LA-criteria trusts and VA schools may measure differently; not checked, straight line assumed. 2024 table rows were checked against the identical table in two booklets. PAN from the Sept 2026 booklet directory (Delta 15 and St John's CE 17 as printed). Postcodes from the booklet, checked against GIAS (all match). Types from GIAS (Hadley Wood is now an academy converter; the booklet says Community). Excluded junior schools: Carterhatch Junior, Hazelwood Junior, Raglan Junior, St Michael at Bowes CE Junior. 2026: Forty Hill, Freezywater St George's, Our Lady of Lourdes, St Michael's and St Paul's are in neither the table nor the demand-met list (not_published).
